learningPoints.englishExplanation: To transform or change something from one form or condition into another.

learningPoints.exampleEn: A good software engineer can turn messy code into clean programs.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To accept new duties, tasks, or leadership roles in a workplace or context.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: İş yerinde veya bir projede yeni görevler ve sorumluluklar üstlenmek.
learningPoints.exampleEn: I am ready to take on more responsibility in my next role.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Bir sonraki rolümde daha fazla sorumluluk üstlenmeye hazırım.
